title: Dark Souls: Beyond death. Book 1.
description: To date, the Dark Souls saga is one of the most important in the gaming industry. She launched the whole soulslike subgenre, and her games are well known for their difficulty and rich, mysterious universe. This book will give you a glimpse behind the scenes of the creation of the iconic franchise. Damien Meschery and Sylvain Romier describe the combat mechanics and unusual ENT, talk about the characters and plots of the first three games: Demon's Souls, Dark Souls and Dark Souls II. The gameplay, the universe, the music, the themes, the legacy — everything has been studied down to the smallest detail. Find out how the Souls series was developed, how it was perceived by the gaming community, and how it became a classic and achieved such fantastic success!

title: Dark Souls: Beyond Death. Book 2.
description: Bloodborne and Dark Souls III are some of the most popular games developed by FromSoftware. They share many gameplay elements, level design and style, and are famous for their high difficulty and unusual world. This book will immerse you in the unique worlds of Hidetaki Miyazaki's two legendary games. In the previous volume, Damien Meschery and Sylvain Romier told the story of the first three games in the series, and now they will introduce readers to Bloodborne and Dark Souls III. They will present every aspect: the world, the plot, the characters, the themes and, of course, the music and the legacy. You will learn about how each game was created, what ideas underlie them and how they influenced the gaming industry. The book also offers an interesting analysis of the gameplay and mechanics that make these games so exciting and beloved.
